title: WeftMeta
description: The `weft` annotation of a part of a schema.

verb.description: The branch of an input that is one action of this verb.

read.description: The value of `<object>.<key>` in the state.

pool.description: Each drawn value of this part goes to this Hegel pool.

maxLeaves.description: The most leaves of one value of a schema that names itself.

grammar.description: A Lark grammar of the texts of this part.

start.description: The start rule of the grammar.
